sections.heading: Playing Strategies
sections.wikitext:
Ignatius: Walking Volcano is one of the more powerful [[Titans]] at the disposal of the [[Huntik Foundation]]. With his '''Burn''' ability active, his ATK and DEF are increased to 6 at the cost of a card being discarded. Due to the effect of '''Burn''', he is the perfect partner for [[TCG:SAS-013|Metagolem: Icon of History]] as Metagolem cannot be played while having cards in one's hand.
